campaign_guide_intro: Campaigns help people coordinate environmental measurements around a topic, a map area, and clear measurement requirements. They do not require formal participation: public matching measurements can contribute automatically.
campaign_listing_description: Create and discover public campaigns that describe which environmental phenomena should be measured in a specific area.
create_campaign_description: Describe the goal, requirements, phenomena, and area for a public measurement campaign.
no_campaigns_text: Try changing the filters or create the first campaign.
campaign_map_description: Browse the currently visible campaigns by their measurement area.
guide_summary_area_text: A campaign starts with a polygon area where measurements should be evaluated.
guide_summary_measurements_text: Choose phenomena, a time range, and coverage targets that explain what good contribution means.
guide_summary_coordination_text: Use organizer updates and an optional discussion link to keep participants aligned.
guide_create_description: A good campaign is specific enough that others can understand what to measure and where help is needed.
guide_create_step_goal: Write a clear goal and explain why these measurements matter.
guide_create_step_phenomena: Choose one or more phenomena that match existing openSenseMap sensor names.
guide_create_step_area: Draw or upload the campaign area as a polygon.
guide_create_step_grid: Pick a coverage grid and decide how many devices and measurements each cell needs.
guide_create_step_discussion: Add a Discourse topic or other discussion link when coordination needs a longer conversation.
guide_create_step_updates: Post organizer updates when requirements, priorities, or timing change.
guide_contribute_description: Contributing usually means making relevant public measurements in the campaign area. You do not need to formally join.
guide_contribute_step_browse: Browse campaigns by topic, status, bookmarks, or map area.
guide_contribute_step_device: Check whether one of your public devices measures a required phenomenon in the campaign area.
guide_contribute_step_measure: Keep the device online and measuring during the campaign period.
guide_contribute_step_coverage: Use the coverage map to see which cells still need more measurements.
guide_contribute_step_discussion: Use the discussion link for questions, field coordination, and local context.
guide_contribute_step_bookmark: Bookmark campaigns you want to follow later.
guide_coverage_text: Coverage translates raw measurements into a simple map of where the campaign already has enough data and where more devices or measurements would help.
guide_coverage_point_cells: The campaign area is split into same-sized grid cells.
guide_coverage_point_requirements: Each cell is evaluated against the organizer's required devices and measurements.
guide_coverage_point_gaps: Empty or partial cells show where additional measurements can be most useful.
guide_organize_text: The organizer should keep the campaign understandable after it has been published.
guide_organize_point_updates: Use organizer updates for official notices, reminders, and changed priorities.
guide_organize_point_discussion: Use the linked discussion topic for questions and open-ended coordination.
guide_organize_point_results: Review contributing devices and coverage to explain progress and results.
guide_bookmarks_text: Bookmarking helps users find a campaign again. It is not a formal sign-up and does not imply that a user contributed measurements.
title: Title
discussion_url_help: Optional link to a Discourse topic or another external discussion space.
measurement_requirements_description: These targets define when an area cell is considered covered by existing openSenseMap measurements.
grid_size_help: A 6 x 6 grid is a good default. Larger grids are more detailed but need more measurements.
campaign_area_description: Draw a polygon by clicking on the map, or upload/paste a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with one Polygon feature.
draw_area_hint: Click at least three points on the map to create a polygon.
map_loading_geojson_fallback: The interactive map editor is still loading. You can paste GeoJSON here and submit the campaign.
bookmark_campaign_description: Save this campaign to find it again later. Bookmarking does not count as participation.
campaign_discussion_description: Use the linked discussion space for questions, coordination, and longer conversations.
organizer_updates_description: Short campaign notices from the organizer.
organizer_update_placeholder: Share a short update, request, or change of plan for this campaign.
no_organizer_updates: No organizer updates have been posted yet.
contributing_devices_description: Public devices with matching sensors and measurements in this campaign area.
no_contributing_devices: No matching public devices have contributed measurements yet.
measurements_note_text: Formal participation is not required. A future slice can evaluate matching measurements from devices in this area and time range.
